note: What a scan must hand the administrator. Produced on the device or the mounted drive, never by this repository reaching outward. Written so a Shortcut, a shell one-liner and scripts/mfile-scan.mjs can all emit the same shape.

ext.note: lowercased, no dot; empty string is legal

content_hash.note: sha256 hex. Absent is legal and degrades duplicate to candidate — it never fabricates one.
